value.text: Got the link, thanks. Preschool Sports and Games is set for Wednesdays at 10:30 AM, and it fits Maya's age band of 3 to 5. It costs $280.60, or $290.60 if you're a non-resident, with course code 00028147. The town's page says residents can register from Sep 8, and the public opens Tuesday, September 15 at 10:30 a.m. I had Monday, September 14 at 10:30 a.m. before, but I'm going by the page now. The page also lists a registration form I can't see, so leave some time to fill that in before the window opens. I haven't registered Maya for anything. Let me know once you've picked the class.
